title: Synapse webhook envelope (v1)
description: The default body of a generic webhook channel: the event's template variables filtered to the channel's effective data class. Sent with X-Synapse-Body: envelope.

event_type.description: A catalog event type, for example scan.completed.

data_class.description: The class the variables were filtered to: the lower of the channel class and the engagement override.

variables.description: The event type's catalog variables at or below data_class. Every value is a string; times are RFC 3339 UTC. A variable without a value is absent.
